content: Yesu yi kufwa kwa longu
Tangwa kámanisa Yesu ndinga zazi, wákatuka ku Ngadidi amana wenda ku milambu mya Yuteya, kuna sambwa dikwawu dya Yolutani.
Milumba-lumba mya batu lawu bámulanda, amana kwakuna, wábuka bambefu.
Amana ndambu ya Bafwadisi bábwesuka kwena yandi, mu kumuleya yi kumuhyula: «Yakala kenina yi muswa wa kuyambula mukhetu wandi mu kosu kikuma?»
Amana yandi mu kuvutula, wuzimbudi: «Lwátangaku ni, "ku luyanduku, kábahanga mukhetu yi yakala",
amana kázimbula: "Ihana ni, yakala kasísa tata wandi yi ngudi wandi, amana kakhúndakana yi mukhetu wandi, amana bakítuka, bawu bodi, musuni wumosi".
Ndangu bakálaku hika bodi, kaasi mutu mosi. Disongidila, kina kakasi Nzambi, mutu kahambulaku.»
Bafwadisi bamuzimbwadini: «Kikuma kya biki Moyize káhanina muswa ni bahana, kwena mukhetu, mukanda wa kufwa kwa longu amana bamukula?»
Yandi wubazimbwadi: «Moyize, kikuma kya mbundu ya tadi yina lwenina yawu, káluhekila muswa wa kukula bakhetu benu; ku luyandiku, bwákalaku buna.
Kaasi, yiluzimbwadibwa: wuna wayámbula mukhetu wandi, katula kusala kindumba, amana kakwela wa hika, mbongi katini.»
Balonguki bandi bámuzimbwala: «Yuka ni yi bwana dyenina dyambu dya yakala yi mukhetu, bulungi kakwelaku kwandi.»
Amana yandi wábazimbwala: «Boosu bafwaniyoku kutambwasa ndinga yayi, kaasi kwena bawu bana lwesi bahekaya!

Mukuma henina yi bayakala bafwaniku kukwela kikuma bwabuna bábutuka, henina yi bakwawu bátyelabwa kwena batu, amana henina yi bakwawu bábwisa kukwela, kikuma kya Kipfumu kya mazilu. Wuna wufwani kutambwasa, katambwasa!»
Yesu yi bana bakhunda
Hanga bamunatini bana, ndangu kabathetika moku amana kalombila kikuma kya bawu, kaasi balonguki bakala bakaya.
Amana Yesu wázimbula: «Yambulenu bana, lubakandisaku mu kukwisa kwena meni, mukuma Kipfumu kya mazilu kyenina kikuma kya bana benina hanga bawu.»
Amana wábathetika moku, wákatuka hana.
Yesu yi ngunza wa mvwama
Hanga mutu mosi wisa bwesuka kwena yandi, wuzimbudi: «Mulongi, biki bya bukheti pfwani kuhanga mu kutambula luzingu lwa mvula yi mvula?»
Amana yandi wumuzimbwadi: «Kikuma kya biki wungyufwadi mu mambu ma bukheti? Mosi lwesi wenina wa bukheti. Amana yuka ni wazola kukota mu luzingu lwa mvula yi mvula, lunda mitsiku.»
Wumuhyudi: «Khi myawu?» Amana Yesu wuzimbudi: «Wahóndaku mvumbi wa khengu; watáku mbongi; wayíbaku; wahúnaku musamu;
zitisa tata waku yi ngudi waku; amana wazóla mukwenu khunda hanga ngeyi meni.»
Ngunza wumuzimbwadi: «Mambu mana moosu, yisima zitisa, biki hika bikhondi?»
Yesu wumuzimbwadi: «Yukani wuzodi wakala walungila, ndawenda, tekisa bima byaku, amana wahana mbongu kwena batsukami, amana wátambula kuvwa kumosi mu mazilu, kunima, nzawisa amana wandanda.»
Amana mu kayuka, ngunza, ndinga yina, wenda yi kiwayi mukuma kimvwama kya lawu kakala kyawu.
Yesu wázimbula kwena balonguki bandi: «Mu kyedika, yiluzimbwadi: phasi bwenina kwena mvwama mosi mu kukota mu Kipfumu kya mazilu.
Amana yiluzimbwadi hika: bweku phasi kwena kamela mu kulobuka ha hundu dya ndongu, kuluta mvwama mu kukota mu Kipfumu kya Nzambi.»
Amana mu kuyuka bwabuna, balonguki báyituka lawu, bakala zimbula: «Nati si wufwani kuhuluka?»
Amana Yesu buna kabatala, wubazimbwadi: «Mana misiku lendakana kwena batu, misi lendakana kwena Nzambi.»
Hanga Phetelu wumuzimbwadi: «Tala betu, tusisi bima byetu byosu amana tulandi ngeyi. Abweti dyakála kikuma kya betu?»

Amana Yesu wábazimbwala: «Mu kyedika yiluzimbwadi: kwena benu lwisa ndanda: mu tsi ya pha, tangwa kazákala Mwana wa mutu hana kiti kyandi kya luyalu lwa khembu, benu phi lwakála bazakala muna biti kumi yi byodi bya luyalu mu kufundisa bikanda kumi yi byodi bya Kiseledi.

Amana kosu mutu wuna wásisa nzu holo baphangi ba bayakala holo baphangi ba bakhetu, holo tata holo ngudi holo bana holo mafu kikuma kya khumbu ya meni, katámbula mbala khama kuluta amana kavwa luzingu lwa mvula yi mvula.
Lawu bakála batheti, basúkinina amana lawu bakála batsuka, batékila.»
